correctness.rationale: Both constant palindromes require k occurrences of each bit, establishing a 2k minimum, attained by concatenations of k 01/10 blocks. For each palindrome target the greedy prefix-embedding coordinate updates with each appended host bit. Branch pruning when matched length plus remaining positions<k is sound and exhaustive; every balanced host is visited once modulo bit-complement pairing. At accepted hosts, the greedy binary arch count equals unrestricted scattered-subsequence universality index. Independently wrote, compiled and executed a new exact C enumeration over k=1..15 with the same mathematical acceptance criterion but independent implementation, reconstructing every row and in particular 760884/32768/72; original C11 and separate unpruned Python verifier through k10 were read. A finite exhaustive proof covers exactly k1..15 and says nothing about k>15.
residual_risks: The independently generated exhaustive implementation still shares the same mathematical greedy automaton criterion; the original unpruned cross-check was limited to k≤10. No closed all-k formula is claimed.
